name: The Road to Darnassus
label: Quest
description: The main road connecting the settlement of Dolanaar to the night elf capital of Darnassus is under constant threat from corrupted Gnarlpine furbolgs.…
intro: The main road connecting the settlement of Dolanaar to the night elf capital of Darnassus is under constant threat from corrupted Gnarlpine furbolgs. Moon Priestess Amara coordinates scouts and travelers to keep this crucial trade and messenger route clear of ambushes.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The road to Darnassus must be kept safe. Travelers heading from Dolanaar to Darnassus have been reporting ruthless attacks by corrupted furbolgs from the Gnarlpine tribe.
Important news and commerce travels to and from Darnassus by way of this road daily. We cannot afford to have a rogue band of heathens terrorizing people.
Take up arms in the name of the sacred forest, adventurer. Their den lies somewhere below this vantage point. Slay 6 of these Gnarlpine ambushers and report back to me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The road is still not safe, adventurer. Travel forth and slay 6 Gnarlpine Ambushers and return to me.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have served the good people of Dolanaar and Darnassus well, brave adventurer. As a member of the Sentinel force of Teldrassil I salute your efforts.
